central_question: How can a conversation become a reviewable coding task while retaining context and access boundaries?
claims_and_limits: The @GitHub Slack and Teams integration is generally available; this is not a guarantee of autonomous success.
Teams Canvas provides collaborative view of plans, changes and previews; origin attribution is added to resulting issues and PRs.
A shared Slack thread may become agent context, and shared versus direct-message sessions use different identities; permission and human review remain consequential.

visual.shared_motif: Purple team conversation flowing into a cloud coding session and a pull request, with a human reviewer at the end.
visual.status: Conceptual editorial illustration; not a screenshot, automatic-merge promise or exact software architecture.
